pages.title: Optical Workshop
pages.text: Grinding spindles, polishing laps and an interferometer: blanks become lenses, plates and gratings, true to a fraction of a wavelength.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

Set the two surface curvatures: the lens power is P = (n − 1)(C₁ − C₂). Polish until the surface error is below what the piece needs - a quarter of a wavelength for a lens, less for correctors and gratings. Crystals need a Laue Pattern to be cut along their lattice; glass does not.

pages.name: Optical Workshop
pages.text: Cycling blocks: any of them fits (Interface Ports, higher coil/emitter tiers). Rotate, zoom and view layers in $(thing)JEI$().

$(thing)Machine data$(): a multiblock (16 item and 16 fluid inputs, 4 and 4 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Beam Splitter, Echelle Grating, Einstein Ring Lens, Fluorite Lens, Fused Silica Lens, Laser Rod, Moissanite Lens, Perfect Crystal Interferometer, Photonic Lens, Sapphire Window, Schmidt Corrector Plate, Test Mass.
